pwa-guide.title: Installation
pwa-guide.description: Depending on the browser, this may look a little different. Find the "Add to Home Screen" option in the browser menu (which is usually opened by a button in the corner of the screen), then select "Install." The app will appear as an icon on your device's home screen or desktop.
pwa-guide.ios-description: Unfortunately, web application installation on iOS only works in Safari browser. To install the app, open Safari's menu (the box with an arrow pointing up), then scroll down and select "Add to Home Screen." The app will appear as an icon on your device's home screen.
pwa-guide.image-hint: Click the image to open it in a new view and be able to zoom in
pwa-guide.android-recommendation: NOTE: It looks like you're on an Android device. We strongly recommend you to use this installation method (click to see) instead of the one below.

server-unavailable.description: It's either due to your internet connection or the app server being down. No data can be loaded. Check your connection or try again later.

no-internet.description: Data can't be loaded until you're online again

data-unavailable.description: Couldn't load data - this might be due to a problem with your connection, the app server, a bad URL, or missing permissions.

not-found.description: The data you wanted to view hasn't been found. This is likely due to a bad URL or a problem with internet/server connection. Try going back to the app home page.

bad-url.description: Try going back to the home page

unauthorized.description: Session expired - please log in again (Conversations list > Options > App settings > Log out). Otherwise, you won't be able to load any data.

server-error.description: The server has returned an unexpected internal error. Contact the administrator if the issue persists.

data-invalid.description: Provided data is invalid. Check if the input is correct.

too-many-requests.description: You have exceeded the actions limit on the server and it denies access. This may happen if you click very quickly or if there are too many users in your network. Please try again later.

too-many-messages.description: Too many messages sent in a short period. Please wait a moment and try again.

too-many-login-attempts.description: Too many login attempts have been detected for this account. Please try again later or contact the administrator for help.

unknown.description: An unknown error has occurred. If the issue persists, try restarting the app completely or contact the administrator.

logout-failed.description: An error occurred while logging out (may be a server connection issue). If logout is necessary, try erasing the browser/application data.

notifications-blocked.description: To enable notifications, you have to go to your browser or device settings and manually allow them (this is out of the app's control)

notifications-unknown-error.description: An unknown error occurred while trying to enable notifications, and your browser does not provide us any more information on it. Try restarting the app, changing settings, internet browser, or, if you're using phone, downloading the native Android app from the settings menu
